# Polished Mastering

> Online audio mastering studio for Metal & Gothic, based in Lower Saxony, Germany. Every project starts with a full written audio audit of the mix before mastering begins. Mastered personally by Tim Borchert (Systematic Musicology, University of Hamburg). No AI mastering.

Polished specializes in mastering for Black Metal, Death Metal, Doom, Gothic and Metalcore/Djent. Every package includes a full audio audit (frequency spectrum, dynamics and loudness, stereo image and phase, sonic assessment against genre references), a documented mastering plan, and unlimited revisions. Delivery: 24-bit WAV, 16-bit AIFF, 320 kbps MP3, plus streaming and Bandcamp versions. Communication in English or German.

## Services and prices
All prices are final prices including 19% German VAT. No upfront payment: projects are invoiced after delivery.
- Stereo Mastering, single track: €79 (48–72h)
- Stem Mastering, single track, up to 6 stems: €129 (48–72h)
- EP Mastering, up to 5 tracks: €349 (5–7 days; €46 less than 5 singles)
- Album Mastering, up to 10 tracks, vinyl master on request: €629 (7–14 days; €161 less than 10 singles)
- Rush delivery in 24h on request

## Genre pages
- [Black Metal Mastering](https://polished.media/black-metal-mastering/): raw, atmospheric, melodic/symphonic and DSBM; harshness, cymbal wash and low-end control
- [Death Metal Mastering](https://polished.media/death-metal-mastering/): OSDM, technical, brutal/slam, melodic death and deathcore; low-mid weight and blast-beat clarity
- [Doom & Gothic Mastering](https://polished.media/doom-gothic-mastering/): doom, funeral doom, sludge, gothic metal, gothic rock, darkwave; dynamics and low end
- [Metalcore & Djent Mastering](https://polished.media/metalcore-djent-mastering/): extended-range low end, breakdowns, clean/screamed vocals

## Guides
- [How loud should metal be mastered?](https://polished.media/metal-mastering-loudness/): streaming loudness targets by platform (Spotify -14 LUFS, Apple Music about -16 LUFS), typical LUFS ranges by metal subgenre, true-peak limits
